claim: Carbon remains an alternative beside SiC, with no sourced-compression float; corrected axial load is about 701 kN.
source_report_body:
QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. MAINLINE-060 complete.

Compression: ultra-high-modulus pitch laminates (K13D2U class) are sourced at 340-380 MPa unidirectional; the one independent measurement sits 15% below its data sheet. Scatter is CV 5-6% (m about 20). No tube or multidirectional tests exist. 50/20/20/10 fails first-ply at 0.19 GPa: 11.4 times below 2.16 GPa, and 3.65 times below what its stiffness-sized wall carries.

Whole bill (052 line by line, 054's one- and seven-day cavity, R 10-30): no carbon frame floats on sourced compression, even at mean strength with every 052 endpoint and ground service. Best at mean: M55J 50/20/20/10, -470 kg at R10, -4.6 t at R30. Best meeting Pf 1e-3 with carbon's own scatter: M55J 70/10/10/10, -2.0 t at R10, -47 t at R30. M55J tubes weigh 1.12-1.14 times SiC's; floating allows 1.007-1.079.

Only K13D2U 50/20/20/10 floats, and only with compression ignored: +619 kg at R10, +24.8 t at R30. It needs 0.59 GPa laminate at mean (UD 1.06 GPa), UD 1.94 GPa for Pf 1e-3, 3.07 GPa size-scaled. Titanium fittings at a sourced strut share delay floating to R12.

Hail: the design strike carries about 32 J, 7-8 times below ice delamination of flat PAN-carbon panels. No pitch, tube or preloaded data.

Answer: not a better lead than SiC.

Grounding test: compress about 30 full-length K13D2U 50/20/20/10 tubes with fittings to failure; floating needs 0.59 GPa, data predict 0.19. 12 NFI.

qualification: Neither is a global impossibility proof. The corrected hypothetical TRL7 row is not achieved maturity; rejected carbon cases do not qualify SiC. [CHECK057](unpublished-local-ref:68eae3652d6c0a12), [CHECK060](unpublished-local-ref:d8968524247a969e).
